name: UHSAA State Cross Country Championships
where: Salt Lake City, UT · Sugar House Park
headline: UHSAA State Cross Country Championships
summary: Utah's six classes over two days: 6A, 3A and 5A on Tuesday, 2A, 1A and 4A on Wednesday. No. 6 American Fork and No. 7 Riverton boys and No. 5 Lone Peak girls are in DyeStat's national top 10. · Tue–Wed Oct 27–28 · 6A 11:00 a.m. MT Tue · 2A 11:00 a.m. Wed
